items.title: 66086_Zilner T. Randolph oral history interview
items.q: like the Carpenter and Dunlop smoking the Louis Armstrong special cigar

ctx.x: Beautiful, beautiful, unaccompanied thing. There's an awful lot of humor on those records, and a lot of talking

back and forth, and Louis would talk about people in the studios, like the Carpenter and Dunlop smoking the Louis Armstrong special cigar. I presume he meant cigar, he just said the Louis Armstrong Special. I don't know what --
